response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS trader_type, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS analysed_trade_records FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind) SELECT trader_type, analysed_trade_records, analysed_trade_records * 1.0 / SUM(analysed_trade_records) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM counts ORDER BY trader_type;
